spans.s: Rāghava, dual (ºau) (do.) = Rāma and Lakshmaṇa: III, 16285.
Rāghava, pl. (ºāḥ) (do.). § 770 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 151, 7155 (Somādityānvayāḥ sarve Rºāḥ Kuravas tathā).

Raghu, an ancient king. § 6 (Anukram.): I, 1, 226 (in Sañjaya's enumeration). § 552 (Goharaṇap.): IV, 56, 1769 (came on the chariot of Indra to see the encounter).-§ 656 (Khaḍgotpattik.): XII, 166, 6197 (received the sword from Yuvanāśva, from him it passed over to Hariṇāśva). --§ 761 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 115, 5661 (abstained from meat during the month of Kārttika).--§ 770 (do.): XIII, 151, 7160 (saṃgrāmajid bhavati caiva Rºṃ namasyan). § 775 (do.): XIII, 166, 7677 (enumeration).
Raghukulodvaha (“propagator of the Raghu family”) = Lakshmaṇa: III, 16203.
Raghunandana (“descendant of Raghu”) = Rāma Dāśarathi: III, 11215, 16038, 16345, 16558, 16600.
